data.title: Date Finding: Finding dates on a monthly calendar
data.description: Practice date finding on the calendar.

challenges.question: What day of the week is March 15, 2025?
challenges.hint: Find March 15 on the calendar and look at the top of that column for the day of the week.
challenges.narration: Let's find out what day of the week March 15th falls on in 2025!

challenges.question: What date is the first Monday of October 2024?
challenges.hint: Look at the Monday column in October 2024 and find the very first number listed.
challenges.narration: Can you help me find the date of the very first Monday in October 2024?

challenges.question: What day of the week is July 4, 2025?
challenges.hint: Find July 4 on the calendar and follow the column straight up to the day name.
challenges.narration: Independence Day is July 4th! Let's check what day of the week it is in 2025.

challenges.question: What date is the third Wednesday of January 2025?
challenges.hint: Find the Wednesday column for January 2025 and count down to the third date.
challenges.narration: Let's count down the Wednesdays in January 2025 to find the third one!

challenges.question: What day of the week is December 25, 2024?
challenges.hint: Find December 25 on the calendar and look up to see which day column it is in.
challenges.narration: Christmas Day is December 25th! What day of the week does it land on in 2024?
